The math lives in calculateRefund(order, selection), a pure function with tests. Order-level discounts are split across lines in proportion to each line’s price, and tax in proportion to each line’s price after discount, with the largest-remainder method so the parts add up to the cent. Each unit then takes a cumulative slice of its line’s share, so refunding units one at a time adds up to exactly what refunding them together would. When the selection takes everything that’s left, the total is set to the amount still available, so earlier rounding never strands a cent.

onRefund receives a RefundRequest and can return a Refund. A succeeded refund closes the sheet, a pending one shows “Refund pending with the bank”, and a failed one or a thrown error shows its message next to the button with everything still filled in. The button guards against double submits, and refunds over half the order or the whole order ask for confirmation first.
